script.problem: Moment 3's passage 1 Kings 17:13-16 doesn't include a verse that names Zarephath in the lessons.

terra.problem: “Jesus remembers the widow” takes place in a synagogue, not in Zarephath. Also, the people become enraged after Jesus speaks about both the widow and Naaman, not just the widow.
“The flour and oil do not run out” omits that the LORD’s promise lasted until He sent rain on the earth (1 Kings 17:14).
